Sagui returns integrated regional photometry that can be fitted with Bagpipes.
This example shows region 8 of Sagui-8.

```{r bagpipes, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.cap="Bagpipes fit to the photometry of Sagui-8, region 8."}
input_file <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
path <- if (is.null(input_file)) {
  system.file(
    "help", "figures", "sagui8_region8_bagpipes_sedfit.png",
    package = "sagui"
  )
} else {
  file.path(dirname(input_file), "..", "man", "figures",
            "sagui8_region8_bagpipes_sedfit.png")
}
knitr::include_graphics(path)
```

Sagui provides the regional fluxes and uncertainties; Bagpipes fits the
physical model.
